options.name: commands
options.description: One or more TSO commands to execute on the target z/OS system. Accepts a single string or list of strings as input. If a list of strings is provided, processing will stop at the first failure, based on rc.

options.name: max_rc
options.description: Specifies the maximum return code allowed for a TSO command. If more than one TSO command is submitted, the I(max_rc) applies to all TSO commands.
